evidence.title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex

summary: Asana leveraged AI, specifically Codex, to accelerate its engineering workflow, completing a backlog equivalent to five years of work in just two weeks. The move highlights the growing impact of AI on productivity in software development.
title: Asana Uses AI to Complete 5 Years of Engineering Work in 2 Weeks
